metadata.title: Circuitera – Free Arduino IDE for Chromebook

checks: Production title and compact Circuitera header
Existing source, open tabs, and active tab restored without data migration
Custom user-typed Blink, Button and Servo compile through real browser WASM Worker
Local digitalWrite autocomplete appears with its signature
About page displays actual capabilities and independent-project notice
Header SVG loaded (512px intrinsic width) and rendered visibly
Production favicon.png returns HTTP 200 image/png (967 bytes)
No old visible branding; no horizontal page overflow

limitations: No physical Uno connected or physical upload retested in this revision.
Uploader/readback and Serial Monitor were tested with the real code and a software serial-port fixture.
A separate bulk HTTP asset audit was interrupted by a network approval cancellation. Production favicon fetch succeeded and About/header/compilation were verified separately in Chrome.
